_source.how: the option cases of section C (wave w2/systemd, journalctl.json, point 26) as root and as uid 1000 (*_user): [stdout, stderr, exit status] of `sh -c` in `docker exec` in containers that boot systemd as PID 1 (helper images w2sd-<key>, docker run --privileged, linux/arm64 Docker Desktop VM, cgroup v2, /run/log/journal a volume; no polkit). Normalised: hostname HOST, 32-hex ids HEX32, weekday/date/time of the list-boots columns Day YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, journal sizes N + unit; the order of the directories vacuum names is the order the container's readdir gave; a stdout of 400 characters or more (the whole journal) is cut to its first line.
